report_name: UK Police National Legal Database (PNLD) Data Breach

threat_actors.name: ExfilSquad
threat_actors.description: An extortion group linked to the data breach of the UK's Police National Legal Database (PNLD). The group exfiltrated user contact information and published it on the dark web.
threat_actors.goals: Extortion and reputational damage through the publication of sensitive data.

attack_patterns.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
attack_patterns.description: Attackers gained initial access to the Police National Legal Database (PNLD) by exploiting its web-facing application. A Microsoft Power Apps portal was speculated as the potential entry point.

attack_patterns.name: Data from Information Repositories
attack_patterns.description: The attackers accessed and collected a user database from the PNLD, which serves as a key information repository for UK law enforcement.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
attack_patterns.description: User data, including names and email addresses, was exfiltrated from the PNLD network to attacker-controlled infrastructure before being published online.

tools.name: Microsoft Power Platform
tools.description: A Microsoft Power Apps portal was speculated to be the public-facing application exploited by attackers to gain initial access to the PNLD.

identities.name: Police National Legal Database (PNLD)
identities.description: A UK-based subscription service providing legal guidance to law enforcement, which suffered a data breach exposing its user database.

identities.name: UK Law Enforcement and Government Personnel
identities.description: A class of victims whose personal and professional contact information was exposed in the PNLD data breach. This includes police officers, staff, and criminal justice partners across 43 Home Office forces.

infrastructure.name: ExfilSquad Dark Web Forum
infrastructure.description: A dark web forum used by the ExfilSquad extortion group to publish the data exfiltrated from the Police National Legal Database (PNLD).

indicators.name: PNLD Service Domain Monitoring
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: PNLD Service Domain DNS Query
id: 4f5e6d7c-8b9a-4123-b456-789012345678
status: experimental
description: 'Detects DNS queries to the PNLD service domain. Monitoring for unusual patterns may indicate reconnaissance or follow-on attacks related to the breach.'
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/08/thermo-fisher-patches-flaw-that-could.html
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-04
tags:
  - attack.t1590
level: low
logsource:
  category: dns_query
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    QueryName|contains:
      - 'pnb.police.uk'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects DNS queries for the pnb.police.uk domain, which is associated with the breached Police National Legal Database. This can be used for hunting and monitoring for related malicious activity.

relationships.target_name: UK Law Enforcement and Government Personnel
